answer: For a unity-gain Sallen-Key with equal resistors, Q = 0.5 sqrt(C1/C2) and f0 = 1/(2 pi R sqrt(C1 C2)). Q = 0.707 needs C1 = 2 C2. With R1 = R2 = 10 kOhm, C1 = 22 nF (feedback) and C2 = 11 nF (to ground) give Q = 0.707 and f0 = 1.02 kHz; for Butterworth the -3 dB point equals f0. The response is flat and falls 40 dB per decade.
